content: 1. Elagolix may reduce the plasma levels or therapeutic effects of norgestrel by inducing hepatic and intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be adjusted, and close monitoring is recommended. Consider using additional barrier contraceptive methods if moderate CYP3A4 inducers are coadministered. 2. Elagolix decreases the levels of olaparib by enhancing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are advised. 3. Elagolix acts as a weak-to-moderate inducer of CYP3A4. When coadministered with CYP3A substrates, monitor their levels and consider increasing their doses if necessary. 4. Elagolix reduces the levels of ombitasvir/paritaprevir/ritonavir and dasabuvir (DSC) by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modifications and close monitoring are required. 5. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of omeprazole by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are recommended. No dose adjustments are needed for omeprazole at doses of 40 mg/day or less. 6. Elagolix decreases omeprazole levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modifications and close monitoring are necessary. 7. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of ondansetron via inhibition of the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Conversely, it decreases ondansetron levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are advised. 8. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of osimertinib via inhibition of the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. It also decreases osimertinib levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modifications and close monitoring are required. 9. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of ospemifene by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism. It also decreases ospemifene levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are recommended. 10. Elagolix reduces oxycodone levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modifications and close monitoring are necessary. 11. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of paclitaxel by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. It also decreases paclitaxel levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are advised. 12. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of paclitaxel protein-bound formulations via inhibition of the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. It also decreases their levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modifications and close monitoring are required. 13. Elagolix reduces palbociclib levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are recommended. 14. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of paliperidone via inhibition of the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and close monitoring are advised. 15. Elagolix decreases panobinostat levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modifications and close monitoring are necessary. 16. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of pantoprazole by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism. Caution is advised with sensitive CYP2C19 substrates. 17. Elagolix reduces paricalcitol levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are required. 18. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of pazopanib via inhibition of the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. It also decreases pazopanib levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modifications and close monitoring are recommended. 19. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of pentamidine by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism. Caution is advised with sensitive CYP2C19 substrates. 20. Pentobarbital reduces elagolix levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and close monitoring are necessary. 21. Elagolix decreases perampanel levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are required. 22. Elagolix reduces pexidartinib levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modifications and close monitoring are recommended. 23. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of phenobarbital by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism. Conversely, phenobarbital reduces elagolix levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are necessary. 24. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of phenytoin by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism. Conversely, phenytoin reduces elagolix levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modifications and close monitoring are advised. 25. Elagolix decreases pimavanserin levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are required. 26. Elagolix reduces pimozide levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modifications and close monitoring are necessary. 27. Elagolix decreases pitolisant levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are recommended. 28. Elagolix reduces polatuzumab vedotin levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modifications and close monitoring are required. 29. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of pomalidomide via inhibition of the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. It also decreases pomalidomide levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are advised. 30. Elagolix reduces ponatinib levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modifications and close monitoring are necessary. 31. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of posaconazole via inhibition of the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Conversely, posaconazole increases elagolix levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are recommended. 32. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of pravastatin via inhibition of the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and close monitoring are advised. 33. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of prednisolone via inhibition of the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and close monitoring are necessary. 34. Elagolix reduces primaquine levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are required. 35. Primidone reduces elagolix levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and close monitoring are advised. 36. Elagolix decreases progesterone intravaginal gel levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modifications and close monitoring are necessary. 37. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of micronized progesterone by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism. It also decreases its levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are recommended. 38. Elagolix reduces quazepam levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modifications and close monitoring are required. 39. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of quinidine via inhibition of the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. It also decreases quinidine levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modifications and close monitoring are advised. 41. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of quinine via inhibition of the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. It also decreases quinine levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are required. 42. Therapy modifications and close monitoring are recommended. 43. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of ranolazine via inhibition of the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. It also decreases ranolazine levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are necessary. 44. Elagolix reduces regorafenib levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modifications and close monitoring are required. 45. Elagolix decreases repaglinide levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are recommended. 46. Elagolix reduces ribociclib levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Conversely, ribociclib increases elagolix levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modifications and close monitoring are necessary. 47. Rifabutin reduces elagolix levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Elagolix also decreases rifabutin levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are required. 48. Rifampin increases elagolix levels through mechanisms other than CYP3A4 induction. Conversely, rifampin reduces elagolix levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modifications and close monitoring are necessary. Limit the concomitant use of elagolix 150 mg daily with rifampin to six months. 49. Rifapentine reduces elagolix levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and close monitoring are advised. 50. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of rifaximin via inhibition of the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and close monitoring are necessary. 51. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of riociguat via inhibition of the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. It also decreases riociguat levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are recommended.
